name: Multi-version dump/restore end-to-end rehearsal
description: Repeated disposable old-major to new-major logical upgrade rehearsals using pg_dump and pg_restore with post-restore validation.

measurement.scope: Top-level linked-run interval from immutable manifest start through terminal verdict; includes topology reset/readiness, source data setup, dump, restore, validation, evidence collection, and cleanup.

assurance: A passing series proves repeated end-to-end dump/restore rehearsal completion and row/version assertions for the exact disposable topology and pack. The wall-clock metric is deliberately scenario-wide; it is not isolated pg_dump or pg_restore throughput, physical pg_upgrade evidence, production downtime, RTO, or recovery assurance.
